title: Combine multiple text files into one new file
summary: Merge the contents of several text files into a single output file. This is often used to combine logs or configuration parts into one document.

steps.explain: Use `cat` with multiple input files and redirect the output to a new file using `>`. This creates a new file containing the contents of all input files in order.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: The new file to create with combined content

alternatives.explain: Append the contents of input files to an existing output file instead of overwriting it, using `>>`.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: The existing file to append to

warnings: Using `>` will overwrite the output file if it already exists. Use `>>` to append instead.

rollback.explain: If you accidentally overwrote a file, you cannot undo this with `cat`. You must restore from a backup or Time Machine.
